entities.name: Graph-Based Indexing
entities.description: A category of methods for enhancing efficiency and speed of query operations on graph databases.

entities.name: Graph Indexing
entities.description: An approach that preserves the entire structure of the graph, ensuring easy access to edges and neighboring nodes.

entities.name: Text Indexing
entities.description: A method involving converting graph data into textual descriptions to optimize retrieval processes.

entities.name: Vector Indexing
entities.description: A common graph-based indexing method mentioned alongside graph and text indexing.

entities.name: BFS
entities.description: A classic graph search algorithm employed to facilitate retrieval tasks.

entities.name: Shortest Path Algorithms
entities.description: Classic graph search algorithms employed to facilitate retrieval tasks.

entities.name: sparse retrieval
entities.description: A text-based retrieval technique applied to text corpora derived from graph data.

entities.name: dense retrieval
entities.description: A text-based retrieval technique applied to text corpora derived from graph data.

relationships.description: Graph Indexing is a common method included in Graph-Based Indexing.
Text Indexing is a common method included in Graph-Based Indexing.
Vector Indexing is a common method included in Graph-Based Indexing.
BFS is employed during retrieval stages following Graph Indexing.
Shortest Path Algorithms are employed during retrieval stages following Graph Indexing.
Sparse retrieval is a text-based technique applied to the text corpus created by Text Indexing.
Dense retrieval is a text-based technique applied to the text corpus created by Text Indexing.
